## Definition of Done

<!-- Standard checklist — all boxes must be checked before closing this issue. -->

- [ ] Code is written and follows project coding standards
- [ ] All linting and type checks pass (Ruff, Black, MyPy / ESLint, tsc)
- [ ] Unit and/or integration tests written and passing
- [ ] CI pipeline passes (backend + frontend where applicable)
- [ ] Code reviewed and approved by at least 1 maintainer
- [ ] Documentation updated (API spec, schema, README, etc.)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] Deployed to staging and verified (if applicable)
